---
title: "Students"
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")
d <- seec_read_data()

updated <- with_tz(Sys.time(), "Africa/Johannesburg")

current <- d$current_students %>%
  mutate(Group = degree_group(Degree), start = `First registered`)

past <- d$past_students %>%
  mutate(Group = degree_group(Degree), start = `First Registered`,
         end = `Graduation Year`)

# Everyone with a known start year, with the year they left (NA = still registered)
cohort <- bind_rows(
  current %>% transmute(Group, start, end = NA_integer_),
  past %>% transmute(Group, start, end)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start))

first_year <- max(min(cohort$start), 2014)
years <- first_year:current_year

# Students registered in each year: started on/before it and not yet graduated
enrolled <- tidyr::expand_grid(year = years, cohort) %>%
  filter(start <= year, is.na(end) | end >= year) %>%
  count(year, Group, name = "Students")

graduates <- past %>%
  filter(!is.na(end)) %>%
  count(year = end, Group, name = "Graduates")

completion <- past %>%
  filter(!is.na(end), !is.na(start), end >= start) %>%
  mutate(years_taken = end - start) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = median(years_taken),
    range = paste0(min(years_taken), "–", max(years_taken), " years"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!Group %in% c("Unknown", "Honours"), n >= 3) %>%
  mutate(Group = as.character(Group),
         hover = paste0(n, " graduates · range ", range))

last_full_year <- current_year - 1
grads_last_year <- sum(graduates$Graduates[graduates$year == last_full_year])
grads_this_year <- sum(graduates$Graduates[graduates$year == current_year])
phd_median <- completion$median[completion$Group == "Doctorate"]

current_postdocs <- d$postdocs %>% filter(Year == max(Year, na.rm = TRUE))
```

::: last-updated
Last updated `r format(updated, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")`
:::

```{r}
stat_row(
  stat_tile("Registered students", nrow(current),
            paste0(sum(current$Group == "Doctorate"), " doctoral · ",
                   sum(current$Group %in% c("Masters", "Coursework Masters")), " Masters")),
  stat_tile(paste("Graduates in", last_full_year), grads_last_year,
            paste(grads_this_year, "so far in", current_year)),
  stat_tile("Graduates to date", nrow(past),
            paste("since", min(past$end, na.rm = TRUE))),
  stat_tile("Median time to PhD",
            if (length(phd_median)) paste(phd_median, "years") else "–",
            "from first registration"),
  stat_tile("Postdocs", nrow(current_postdocs),
            paste("in", max(d$postdocs$Year, na.rm = TRUE)))
)
```

## Student body over time

Students counted in every year from first registration until the year they graduated.

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_stacked(
  enrolled, "year", "Group", "Students", degree_colors,
  title = "Registered students per year",
  subtitle = "By degree type",
  unit = " students"
)
```
:::

```{r}
numbers_view(seec_numbers(
  enrolled %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Students, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-year))) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    rename(Year = year),
  columns = list(Year = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = FALSE)))
))
```

## Graduates

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_stacked(
  graduates, "year", "Group", "Graduates", degree_colors,
  title = "Graduates per year",
  subtitle = paste0("By degree type · ", current_year, " is still in progress"),
  unit = " graduates"
)
```
:::

```{r}
numbers_view(seec_numbers(
  graduates %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = Graduates, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-year))) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    rename(Year = year),
  columns = list(Year = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = FALSE)))
))
```

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_hbars(
  completion, "Group", "median",
  title = "Median time to completion",
  subtitle = "Years from first registration to graduation · hover for range",
  label_fmt = function(v) paste(v, "yrs"),
  hover_extra = "hover"
)
```
:::

::: chart-note
Calculated from start and graduation years, so it is accurate to about a year. Honours (a one-year degree) and degree types with fewer than three graduates are not shown.
:::

## Current students

```{r}
by_dept <- current %>%
  mutate(Dept = dept_group(Department)) %>%
  count(Dept, name = "Students")

by_status <- current %>%
  mutate(Status = sentence_case(coalesce(Status, "Not recorded"))) %>%
  count(Status, name = "Students")
```

## Postdoctoral fellows

```{r}
seec_numbers(
  d$postdocs %>%
    count(Year, Department, name = "Postdocs") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Department, values_from = Postdocs, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(Year)),
  columns = list(Year = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = FALSE)))
)
```

## All students

::: panel-tabset
## Current students

```{r}
seec_table(
  d$current_students %>% mutate(Status = sentence_case(Status)),
  id = "current-students",
  columns = list(
    Name = colDef(minWidth = 160),
    `First registered` = colDef(name = "Registered", maxWidth = 110, align = "right"),
    Department = colDef(minWidth = 150),
    Title = colDef(minWidth = 320),
    Supervisors = colDef(minWidth = 200)
  )
)
```

## Past students

```{r}
seec_table(
  d$past_students %>% arrange(desc(`Graduation Year`), Name),
  id = "past-students",
  columns = list(
    Name = colDef(minWidth = 160),
    `First Registered` = colDef(name = "Registered", maxWidth = 110, align = "right"),
    `Graduation Year` = colDef(name = "Graduated", maxWidth = 110, align = "right"),
    Department = colDef(minWidth = 150),
    Title = colDef(minWidth = 320),
    Supervisors = colDef(minWidth = 200)
  )
)
```
:::
